en: Holy Spirit, Your presence is with me
You cover me with perfect peace and embrace
That’s all I’ve ever needed
At the place You’ve called me to
I’ll worship You, Lord
No matter what, I’ll worship my Lord
Wherever I go, I praise You
In whatever I do, I lift You up in praise
I worship You.

ko: 내 생명 다해 내 힘을 다해
en: with all of my life
with all of my strength
all of my hope is in you

ko: 사랑과 진리의 한 줄기 빛 보네
en: Light and the Truth Your love shines down on me
You cover me with perfect peace and embrace
I’m satisfied with Your love
At the place You’ve called me to
I’ll worship You, Lord
No matter what, I’ll worship my Lord
Wherever I go, I praise You
In whatever I do, I lift You up in praise
I worship You.
